message: The other day, I was rummaging through our old storage boxes when I stumbled upon my family's go-bags. I had always been the one who forgot to prepare for things, but this time, I felt a little proud to see them ready and waiting, filled with snacks and water. It made me think about how nice it is to finally be the prepared one for once, especially as a grandparent. It’s those little things that can make life feel a bit steadier, don’t you think?
